review_comment: The DeviceDeleteView uses URL parameters to directly lookup TOTP devices without verifying the requesting user has permission to delete them. While DeviceUpdateView properly scopes queries to the current user's devices, this view bypasses that protection. Add authorization to verify the device belongs to the current user before allowing deletion, similar to the pattern used in DeviceUpdateView's get_queryset method.
